description:
Create a dramatic volumetric lighting scene ('god rays') in Blender.

Starting from the basic scene:
1. Remove or disable the existing Sun light (it washes out the effect).
2. Add a **Spot Light** positioned high up (e.g., Z > 4) and aim it at the cube. Set its Power/Energy high enough to be visible (e.g., 500W+).
3. Create a **Volumetric Fog Domain**: Add a Cube, scale it up to cover the scene (scale ~6+), and assign a new material. In the Shader Editor, delete the 'Principled BSDF' surface node and add a **'Principled Volume'** node connected to the **Volume** output of the Material Output node. Set Density to something subtle (e.g., 0.05 to 0.2).
4. Set the **World Background** color to near black (RGB < 0.1) so the environment is dark.
5. Ensure the Render Engine is set to **Cycles** (required for accurate volumetrics).
6. Render the image and save it to `/home/ga/BlenderProjects/volumetric_render.png`.
7. Save the .blend file to `/home/ga/BlenderProjects/volumetric_scene.blend`.
